per_question.question:
Are there more in-patient or outpatient who were male? What is the deviation in percentage?
(External knowledge: male refers to SEX = 'M'; in-patient refers to Admission = '+'; outpatient refers to Admission = '-'; percentage = DIVIDE(COUNT(ID) where SEX = 'M' and Admission = '+', COUNT(ID) where SEX  = 'M' and Admission = '-'))
answers:
```sql
WITH male_counts AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatient_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_count
    FROM Patient
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN inpatient_count > outpatient_count THEN 'in-patient'
        WHEN outpatient_count > inpatient_count THEN 'outpatient'
        ELSE 'equal'
    END AS group_with_more_males,
    CAST(inpatient_count AS REAL) / NULLIF(outpatient_count, 0) AS percentage
FROM male_counts;
```

This query compares male in-patient and male outpatient counts and returns the larger group with their count ratio.
[rows]
outpatient | 0.8317757009345794
sqls:
WITH male_counts AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatient_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_count
    FROM Patient
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN inpatient_count > outpatient_count THEN 'in-patient'
        WHEN outpatient_count > inpatient_count THEN 'outpatient'
        ELSE 'equal'
    END AS group_with_more_males,
    CAST(inpatient_count AS REAL) / NULLIF(outpatient_count, 0) AS percentage
FROM male_counts

WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY L.name
ORDER BY SUM(M.home_team_goal + M.away_team_goal) DESC
LIMIT 1;

per_question.question:
In Scotland Premier League, which away team won the most during the 2010 season?
(External knowledge: Final result should return the Team.team_long_name; Scotland Premier League refers to League.name = 'Scotland Premier League'; away team refers to away_team_api_id; away team that won the most refers to MAX(SUBTRACT(away_team_goal, home_team_goal) > 0); 2010 season refers to season = '2009/2010'; won the most refers to MAX(COUNT(*));)
answers:
```sql
SELECT T1.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T1
JOIN Match AS T2
  ON T1.team_api_id = T2.away_team_api_id
JOIN League AS T3
  ON T2.league_id = T3.id
WHERE T3.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
  AND T2.season = '2009/2010'
  AND T2.away_team_goal > T2.home_team_goal
GROUP BY T1.team_api_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;
```

This returns the away team with the most away wins in the Scotland Premier League during the 2009/2010 season.
[rows]
Celtic
sqls:
SELECT T1.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T1
JOIN Match AS T2
  ON T1.team_api_id = T2.away_team_api_id
JOIN League AS T3
  ON T2.league_id = T3.id
WHERE T3.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
  AND T2.season = '2009/2010'
  AND T2.away_team_goal > T2.home_team_goal
GROUP BY T1.team_api_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1
